title: LLM follow-up output
description: Structured output the model must return for a follow-up question (action=ask). Sent to OpenAI as response_format.json_schema with strict=true. answer_type=not_in_facts is the only acceptable answer to a question the facts cannot answer, and must come with no sentences. Prompt::followUpSchema() loads this file.

answer_type.description: cited: the sentences answer the question from the facts. not_in_facts: the facts cannot answer it; the panel shows a fixed sentence pointing to the chart tabs.
